registrationScope: Frozen within Metron before its own error analysis; not a clinical-trial registry or proof the source researchers never compared equations.

source.expectedCountsNotEnforced: Final eligible N must come from prespecified filtering, not hardcoded G0 summary.
source.referenceMeasurement: Published fasting indirect calorimetry, COSMED Quark RMR; RMR.KJ measured energy, not model-derived BMR.
source.access: Read publicly released file transiently, verify SHA-256 before parsing, never commit rows/IDs or print individual values.

variables.mappingMeaning: Recorded study sex category mapped only to published equation's binary parameter, never inferred gender identity.
variables.parse: CSV comma-delimited; trim Unicode; numeric finite decimal dot or unambiguous comma as decimal, no thousands separators; reject ambiguous malformed forms.
variables.ffmMethod: SECA 515 bioimpedance-estimated FFM, not laboratory reference fat-free mass.

primaryEligibility.target: Adult participants within Metron core input domain, measured positive finite RMR, source equation parameter available.

orderedRules.action: Abort if release SHA-256 mismatch, don't substitute data.
Abort if required headers missing/ambiguous or malformed CSV rows; don't guess columns.
Abort if any participant code blank/duplicated; don't choose a favorable repeat.
Keep only exact source männlich/weiblich mapped to model equation parameter; count excluded invalid/absent.
Age finite and 18<=age<=105 years (Metron input support).
Height finite and 100<=height<=250 cm (Metron input support).
Mass finite and 25<=weight<=350 kg (Metron input support).
RMR.KJ finite and >0; no upper cutoff or exclusions based on agreement with a model.

primaryEligibility.reporting: Counts by raw input missing/invalid; exclusion flow counts using first-failed rule; preserve multi-reason counts too. Final N not assumed to equal 454.
primaryEligibility.sitePolicy: Retain source Site codes and their sample sizes; do not pool workbook/Kiel records.
primaryEligibility.duplicatePolicy: Abort unexpected duplicate participant ID and amend before any model error is evaluated.
primaryEligibility.outcomeValidity: Positive finite measured RMR only; outlying valid positives retained and their influence described, not silently excluded.

mifflin.comparisonRole: primary baseline on all primary eligible people

cunningham.eligibleFfm: Finite 5–150 kg inclusive and FFM<=weight in participants already primary eligible.
cunningham.limitation: Cunningham historically described basal expenditure using lean mass; present source FFM is BIA-estimated. Compare against measured RMR with caveats.

models.pairedComparison: Use exact same eligible IDs for Mifflin and Cunningham on FFM-complete subset; never compare unequal-population MAEs.

conditionalPairedDelta.name: Cunningham minus Mifflin MAE
conditionalPairedDelta.formula: MAE_C - MAE_M on same people; positive means Mifflin lower MAE

metrics.numericPrecision: No intermediate rounding; JSON unrounded and human display one decimal kcal/day and one decimal percent.
metrics.sensitivitySubset: Age 19–78, the original Mifflin development age range, reported as secondary without switching the main cohort after seeing results.

resampling.method: Nonparametric participant-level bootstrap stratified by recorded Site
resampling.pooledStrata: Within each Site sample as many participant IDs with replacement as observed to preserve site share; not generalizability across laboratories.
resampling.pairedRule: Resample identical IDs for paired Cunningham and Mifflin analysis, without separate independent draws.
resampling.interval: 95% percentile interval, 2.5th/97.5th empirical quantiles via linear interpolation at index (B-1)*q after sorting.
resampling.algorithmNote: G2 must declare/version PRNG algorithm and prove repeatability with seed; seed alone insufficient.
resampling.interpretation: Confidence intervals describe sampling variability in this study's aggregate metrics, not individual prediction uncertainty or new-laboratory transportability.

subgroups.purpose: Exploratory descriptive heterogeneity, not causal inference or confirmatory claim.
subgroups.smallNRule: Show n but suppress subgroup accuracy and confidence interval if n<30; don't merge groups after looking at error.
subgroups.uncertainty: Within each eligible subgroup, participant bootstrap with 5000 replicates, preserve sites as strata where applicable.
subgroups.multiplicity: No subgroup winner declarations, p-value fishing or causal interpretation.

safeguards.amendmentPolicy: Keep protocol.v1.json unchanged after freeze. Subsequent changes create protocol.v2.json with linked reason and are labelled exploratory when outcomes have been seen.

reporting.decisionRule: No automatic change to Metron default; separate documented decision with counterevidence and replication considerations.
